data_fields.name: attack_bonus_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 when the ability is missing on the character

data_fields.name: crit_extra_dice_rolls
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 extra roll of the weapon dice on a critical success hit (no bonus added)

data_fields.name: crit_miss_quality_loss
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 point of weapon quality on a critical failure miss

data_fields.name: advantage_roll_count
data_fields.donor_constant: 2d20 keep higher (advantage) or lower (disadvantage); both cancel

best_idea: One opposed check per swing (d20 plus the attacker's bonus, strictly above the defender's armour plus 10), where a natural 20 doubles only the weapon's dice on a hit and a natural 1 that misses costs one point of weapon quality.
decision_why: Frankendom's hit model is the clamped percent roll from the Daggerfall note, and a second d20 model would split the hit rule; weapon-quality decay is not in parity rows 1-22.
acceptance: If built, a server test with a fixed seed would assert that a natural 20 that lands adds one extra roll of the weapon dice and no ability bonus; not planned.
